label: R21-FMA-ALIGN-CUT

implementation.summary: IT_MUL now captures exponent-dependent FMA product/addend sticky alignment into private fma_align payloads; IT_FMA performs the remaining wide compare/add/sub and enters the existing IT_PREP round/pack route.
implementation.latency_policy: FMA only gains one explicit cycle; FMUL, ADD/SUB, conversions, DIV/SQRT and shared pack states are unchanged.
implementation.boundary: real register boundary: IT_MUL -> fma_align{,_lo,_hi} -> IT_FMA
implementation.special_handling: NaN/SNaN/DN, Inf, Inf-times-zero, zero, FZ and exact-cancellation decisions are carried through the private FMA payload without changing raw-bit rules.
implementation.architecture_state: No architectural state, public ports, latency tables, QEMU, QSF or SDC changed.

validation.command: conda run --no-capture-output -n lcvex verilator --lint-only --timing --assert -Wall -Wno-fatal -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM --top-module lcvex_fp_scalar_r21_fma_cut_tb -f rtl/filelist.f tb/sv/lcvex_fp_scalar_r21_fma_cut_tb.sv

validation.coverage: four FMA sign variants in S; normal S/D and paired H; S/D/H subnormal; S FZ/IDC and inexact/IXC; QNaN/SNaN/DN; Inf-times-zero; exact cancellation under RN/RM; IT_FMA pause, valid-drop, kill, reset and exactly-once result window

validation.scope: R20 non-half route closure plus existing half ADD/FMA and pause/kill/reset/valid-drop probes

risks: Merged candidate must update the shared FMA latency expectations and run the required L0-L2 suite; this lane intentionally did not touch shared latency tables or registry.
Quartus/STA timing improvement and post-fit path ordering remain unmeasured until the integration lane submits the candidate to the physical queue.
